senses.gloss: f. (b. h.) Asherah, tree (grove) devoted to idolatry (v. Mov. Phœn. p. 567; Sm. Bibl. Dict. s. v.).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:5">Ab. Zar. III, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:7">7</cite>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 31b:11">Succ. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דמשה</he> an Asherah to which the Mosaic law refers (remnant of anti-Mosaic idolatry).
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:7">Ab. Zar. III, 7</cite>; a. fr.—<he>אֲשֵׁרִים</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 26:2">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXVI</cite>.
